columns.name: Flipkart Product Link
columns.description: Please provide the Flipkart.com link for an existing product for faster listing. Also provide the Seller SKU ID in respective column.

columns.name: Disapproval Reason (if any)

columns.name: Seller SKU ID
columns.description: Seller SKU ID is the identification number maintained by seller to keep track of SKUs. This will be mapped with Flipkart Serial Number.

columns.name: Group ID
columns.description: Group ID refers to a seller given intention to group products of the same design together on product page. For example, group ID will remain the same across size and color variants of a unique design.

columns.name: Parent Variant FSN
columns.description:
Parent Variant FSN refers to the Flipkart Serial Number of a product already created in your catalog, that you want to group your new products with.  

Please fill either Parent Variant FSN Parent Varinat FSN if you are adding new products to an existing group or  Group ID if you are creating a new group

columns.name: Listing Status
columns.description: Inactive listings are not available for buyers on Flipkart

columns.name: MRP (INR)
columns.description: Maximum retail price of the product

columns.name: Your selling price (INR)
columns.description: Price at which you want to sell this listing

columns.name: Fullfilment by
columns.description: Fullfilment of FA listings will be managed by Flipkart

columns.name: Procurement type
columns.description: Information on how the inventory is procured by the seller to fulfill an order

columns.name: Procurement SLA (DAY)
columns.description: Time required to keep the product ready for dispatch. For Express, SLA value is in Hours and for the others, SLA is in Days

columns.name: Stock
columns.description: The maximum stock quantity you can update is 5000 units per location. For MinOQ listings, the limit is 5000 × MinOQ per location.

columns.name: Shipping provider
columns.description: Information on who will ship the item to the customer

columns.name: Local handling fee (INR)
columns.description: Handling fee you want charge a buyer in the same city for listings which are not Flipkart Assured

columns.name: Zonal handling fee (INR)
columns.description: Handling fee you want charge a buyer outside your zone for listings which are not Flipkart Assured

columns.name: National handling fee (INR)
columns.description: Handling fee you want charge a buyer outside your zone for listings which are not Flipkart Assured

columns.name: Length (CM)
columns.description: Length of the package in cms

columns.name: Breadth (CM)
columns.description: Breadth of the package in cms

columns.name: Height (CM)
columns.description: Height of the package in cms

columns.name: Weight (KG)
columns.description: Weight of the final package in kgs

columns.name: HSN
columns.description: code of your product for determining applicable tax rates

columns.name: Luxury Cess
columns.description: Luxury Cess rate if applicable for your listing

columns.name: Country Of Origin
columns.description: Country of origin or manufacturing or country of assembly in case of imported products
dropdown_values: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands

columns.name: Manufacturer Details
columns.description: Name and address of the manufacturer

columns.name: Packer Details
columns.description: Where manufacturer is not the packer,name and address of packer

columns.name: Importer Details
columns.description: Name and address of the importer if the product is being imported

columns.name: Tax Code
columns.description: Flipkart’s tax code which decides the goods and services tax for the listing

columns.name: Minimum Order Quantity (MinOQ)
columns.description: Minimum number of units you want customers to buy

columns.name: Brand
columns.description: Brand refers to a type of product manufactured by a company under a particular name.

columns.name: Model Number
columns.description: Model Number refers to the number assigned by the manufacturers to identify the different products that they offer.

columns.name: Type
columns.description: Type refers to the classification of the product based on its structure or design.

columns.name: Ideal For
columns.description: Ideal For refers to which gender the product would be most suitable for. Note, Baby Boys and Baby Girls can be selected as values for products that are for infants up to 1 year old. While Boys and Girls can be selected as values for products that are applicable till the age of 14 years.

columns.name: Model Name
columns.description: Model Name is the identity of the product that helps in distinguishing it from other products. Please do not include the brand name under this attribute.

columns.name: Base Material
columns.description: Base Material refers to the substance used to make the bezel/case/body of a particular product.

columns.name: Gemstone
columns.description: Gemstone refers to the type of each variety of precious/semi-precious/synthetic gemstones present on the product. If not applicable, please fill 'NA'.

columns.name: Diamond Clarity
columns.description: Diamond Clarity refers to the quality with respect to the existence and visual appearance of internal characteristics of the diamond. If not applicable, please fill 'NA'.

columns.name: Pearl Type
columns.description: Pearl Type refers to the type of Pearls that the product comes with. If not applicable, please fill 'NA'.

columns.name: Certification
columns.description: Certification refers to a document prepared/hallmark by an expert gemologist/gemological laboratory/notified body that describes and validates the authenticity and key characteristics of a precious metal/precious & semi-precious gemstone. In case the product is an artificial??jewellery??item, please fill NA. Also in case of silver jewellery only, where certification is unavailable, please fill NA.

columns.name: Collection
columns.description: Collection refers to the range or set of a given product identified by a common name.

columns.name: Plating
columns.description: Plating refers to the plating given to the body/case material of the product.

columns.name: Silver Weight (g)
columns.description: Silver Weight refers to the weight of silver present in the product. Please ensure that the values entered are in Grams. If not applicable, please fill 'NA'.

columns.name: Diamond Shape
columns.description: Diamond Shape is the style or design used when shaping the diamond.

columns.name: Color
columns.description: Color refers to the shade of the product as specified by the brand on the label or sales package. The value 'Multicolor' should be used if the product features a mix of three or more prominent colors. Possible values include 'Red,' 'Black,' etc

columns.name: Diamond Color Grade
columns.description: Diamond Color Grade refers to the color grade of the diamond according to a grading scale for diamonds in the normal color range used by internationally recognized laboratories. If not applicable, please fill 'NA'.

columns.name: Diamond Weight (carat)
columns.description: Diamond Weight refers to the weight of the diamond only, without packaging. Please ensure that the values entered are in Carats. Possible values are 0.5, 2.5, etc. If not applicable, please fill 'NA'.

columns.name: Main Image URL
columns.description: Image Details - Front View - Front view is a view of the foremost part of a product | Minimum Resolution - 200x1100 | Please see the Image Guidelines sheet for more details.

columns.name: Other Image URL 1
columns.description: Image Details - Model/Mannequin View - Product worn by model/mannequin | Minimum Resolution - 200x1100 | Please see the Image Guidelines sheet for more details.

columns.name: Other Image URL 2
columns.description: Image Details - Size View - Overall dimension of a product | Minimum Resolution - 200x1100 | Please see the Image Guidelines sheet for more details.

columns.name: Other Image URL 3
columns.description: Image Details - Content - Contents of a product | Minimum Resolution - 200x1100 | Please see the Image Guidelines sheet for more details.

columns.name: Other Image URL 4
columns.description: Image Details - Product in package - Earing Viewed on the box | Minimum Resolution - 200x1100 | Please see the Image Guidelines sheet for more details.

columns.name: Occasion
columns.description: Occasion refers to the type of event that the product would be most suitable for.

columns.name: Piercing Required
columns.description: Piercing Required refers to whether there is any piercing required to wear the product or not. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: Earring Back Type
columns.description: Earring Back Type refers to the type of locking mechanism that the earrings have at the back. Possible values are Butterfly Back, Push Back, Screw Back, Locking Back, French Back, Lever Back, Friction Back, Fish Hook Back, etc.

columns.name: Finish
columns.description: Finish refers to the final appearance given to the base material of a product. Possible values are Matte, Glossy, Shimmer, etc.

columns.name: Setting
columns.description: Setting refers to the style used to set the gemstone/s in the product. Possible values are Bezel, Prong, Channel, Bead, Burnish, Pressure, Invisible, Pave, etc. Please mention the name of the gemstone after setting.

columns.name: Silver Purity
columns.description: Silver Purity refers to the purity standard of silver that is present in the product. Possible values are 925 Silver, 999 Silver, etc.

columns.name: Metal Purity
columns.description: Metal Purity refers to the purity standard of the metals present in the product. Possible values are Palladium 950, Palladium 500, etc.

columns.name: Natural/Synthetic Diamond
columns.description: Natural/Synthetic Diamond refers to whether the stone is a natural produced stone or synthetically produced/cultivated in a laboratory/industry. Possible values are Natural Diamond or Synthetic Diamond.

columns.name: Natural/Synthetic Ruby
columns.description: Natural/Synthetic Ruby refers to whether the stone is a natural produced stone or synthetically produced/cultivated in a laboratory/industry. Possible values are Natural Ruby or Synthetic Ruby.

columns.name: Ruby Shape
columns.description: Ruby Shape is the style or design used when shaping a ruby. Possible values are Round, Princess, Heart, Oval, Marquise, Pear, Cushion, Emerald, Asscher, Radiant, etc.

columns.name: Ruby Clarity
columns.description: Ruby Clarity refers to the quality with respect to the existence and visual appearance of internal characteristics of a ruby. Possible values are FL, IF, VVS1, VVS2, VS1, VS2, S1, I1 - I2, I1, I2, 13, I - J, etc.

columns.name: Ruby Weight (carat)
columns.description: Ruby Weight refers to the weight of the ruby only, without packaging. Please ensure that the values entered are in Carats. Possible values are 0.5, 2.5, etc.

columns.name: Natural/Synthetic Emerald
columns.description: Natural/Synthetic Emerald refers to whether the stone is a natural produced stone or synthetically produced/cultivated in a laboratory/industry. Possible values are Natural Emerald or Synthetic Emerald.

columns.name: Emerald Shape
columns.description: Emerald Shape is the style or design used when shaping the emerald. Possible values are Round, Princess, Heart, Oval, Marquise, Pear, Cushion, Emerald, Asscher, Radiant, etc.

columns.name: Emerald Clarity
columns.description: Emerald Clarity refers to the quality with respect to the existence and visual appearance of internal characteristics of the emerald. Possible values are FL, IF, VVS1, VVS2, VS1, VS2, S1, I1 - I2, I1, I2, 13, I - J, etc.

columns.name: Natural/Synthetic Sapphire
columns.description: Natural/Synthetic Sapphire refers to whether the stone is a natural produced stone or synthetically produced/cultivated in a laboratory/industry. Possible values are Natural Sapphire or Synthetic Sapphire.

columns.name: Sapphire Shape
columns.description: Sapphire Shape is the style or design used when shaping the sapphire. Possible values are Round, Princess, Heart, Oval, Marquise, Pear, Cushion, Emerald, Asscher, Radiant, etc.

columns.name: Sapphire Clarity
columns.description: Sapphire Clarity refers to the quality with respect to the existence and visual appearance of internal characteristics of the sapphire/s. Possible values are FL, IF, VVS1, VVS2, VS1, VS2, S1, I1 - I2, I1, I2, 13, I - J, etc.

columns.name: Natural/Synthetic Amethyst
columns.description: Natural/Synthetic Amethyst refers to whether the stone is a natural produced stone or synthetically produced/cultivated in a laboratory/industry. Possible values are Natural Amethyst or Synthetic Amethyst.

columns.name: Amethyst Shape
columns.description: Amethyst Shape is the style or design used when shaping the amethyst. Possible values are Round, Princess, Heart, Oval, Marquise, Pear, Cushion, Emerald, Asscher, Radiant, etc.

columns.name: Amethyst Clarity
columns.description: Amethyst Clarity refers to the quality with respect to the existence and visual appearance of internal characteristics of the amethyst. Possible values are FL, IF, VVS1, VVS2, VS1, VS2, S1, I1 - I2, I1, I2, 13, I - J, etc.

columns.name: Artificial Pearl Material
columns.description: Artificial Pearl Material refers to the substance used to make artificial pearls. Possible values are Glass, Plastic, Crystal, Crushed Shell, etc.

columns.name: Pearl Shape
columns.description: Pearl Shape refers to the physical form of the pearl.

columns.name: Pearl Grade
columns.description: Pearl Grade refers to the quality with respect to the existence and visual appearance of internal characteristics of a pearl. Possible values are BB Grade, A Grade, AA Grade, AA+ Grade, AAA Grade, etc.

columns.name: Pearl Diameter (mm)
columns.description: Pearl Diameter refers to the diameter of the pearl/s used in the product. Please ensure that the values entered are in Millimeters. Possible values are 2.5, 5, etc.

columns.name: Natural/Synthetic Semi-precious Stone
columns.description: Natural/Synthetic Semi-precious Stone refers to whether the stone is a natural produced stone or synthetically produced/cultivated in a laboratory/industry. Possible values are Natural Semi-precious Stone or Synthetic Semi-precious Stone.

columns.name: Semi-precious Stone Type
columns.description: Semi-precious Stone Type refers to the number and type of the varieties of semi-precious stones present on the product. Possible values are 2 Opal, 1 Alexandrite, etc.

columns.name: Semi-precious Stone Shape
columns.description: Semi-precious Stone Shape is the style or design used when shaping the stone. Possible values are Round, Princess, Heart, Oval, Marquise, Pear, Cushion, Emerald, Asscher, Radiant, etc.

columns.name: Items Included
columns.description: Items Included gives the information of all the contents that are sold in the package. Please specify the package information along with the number of each content mentioned before the name. Data should be double colon (::) separated.

columns.name: Video URL
columns.description: Video uploads aren't yet supported on Seller Hub. Please contact Seller Support to add videos to your product listings.

columns.name: Domestic Warranty
columns.description: Domestic Warranty refers to the number of years that the brand supports the domestic warranty of the product.

columns.name: Domestic Warranty - Measuring Unit
columns.description: Domestic Warranty - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the domestic warranty. Units should be filled only in singular form.

columns.name: International Warranty
columns.description: International Warranty refers to the number of years that the brand supports the international warranty of the product.

columns.name: International Warranty - Measuring Unit
columns.description: International Warranty - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the international warranty. Units should be filled only in singular form.

columns.name: Warranty Summary
columns.description: This refers to a brief description on the warranty details of the product. Mostly one-lined information, this should compulsorily have the number of years covered in warranty and the type (domestic or international) of warranty.

columns.name: Warranty Service Type
columns.description: This attribute covers the process on the customer's part to claim the warranty. In case of any repair/damage to the product, who/where the customer has to contact and how would the company then process the customer's request (either by sending an engineer or by asking the customer to bring the product at a certain Service Center etc).

columns.name: Covered in Warranty
columns.description: Covers specific details on what would actually the warranty cover.

columns.name: Not Covered in Warranty
columns.description: This elaborates on the things that, if damaged, will not be repaired/covered under warranty.

columns.name: Closure Type
columns.description: Closure Type refers to the closing mechanism of a earring.

columns.name: Sub Type
columns.description: Sub Type refers to the different secondary types of the earring.

columns.name: Earring Shape
columns.description: Earring Shape refers to the physical form of a product.

columns.name: With Ear Chain
columns.description: With Ear chain refers to whether the earring comes with ear chain or not.

columns.name: Earring Set Type
columns.description: Earring Set Type refers to the different types of earring that set has.

columns.name: EAN/UPC
columns.description: EAN is a 13 digit bar code. In case you have UPC, prefix 0 to make it 13 digits. EAN/UPC is limited to 13 characters (including spaces). If not applicable, Please leave it blank.

columns.name: EAN/UPC - Measuring Unit
columns.description: EAN/UPC - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the external identifier. Units should be filled only in singular form. Possible values are EAN, UPC, etc.

columns.name: Number of Pairs
columns.description: Number of Pairs refers to the number of pairs of earrings sold in the pack. Possible values are 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: Number of Gemstones
columns.description: Number of Gemstones refers to the total number of precious/semi-precious/synthetic gemstones present on the product. For example, if the product contains 2 diamonds and 3 rubies, then fill the attribute 'Number of Gemstones' with '2 Diamonds||3 Rubies'.

columns.name: Design
columns.description: Design refers to the drawing or sketch on the product.

columns.name: Silver Color
columns.description: Silver Color refers to the color of silver used in the product. Possible values are White, Black, etc.

columns.name: Metal Color
columns.description: Metal Color refers to the color of the metals present in the product. Possible values are Black, White, etc.

columns.name: Metal Weight
columns.description: Metal Weight refers to the weight of the metals present in the product. Please mention the name of the metal after the weight in case of multiple metals.

columns.name: Diamond Width (mm)
columns.description: Diamond Width refers to the breadth, broadness or wideness of a diamond. Please ensure that the values entered are in Millimeters. Possible values are 2.5, 5, etc.

columns.name: Diamond Height (mm)
columns.description: Diamond Height refers to the measurement from top to base or head to foot of the diamond. Please ensure that the values entered are in Millimeters. Possible values are 2.5, 5, etc.

columns.name: Ruby Color
columns.description: Ruby Color refers to the ruby's color.

columns.name: Ruby Width (mm)
columns.description: Ruby Width refers to the breadth, broadness or wideness of the rubies. Please ensure that the values entered are in Millimeters. Possible values are 2.5, 5, etc.

columns.name: Ruby Height (mm)
columns.description: Ruby Height refers to the measurement from top to base or head to foot of the ruby. Please ensure that the values entered are in Millimeters. Possible values are 2.5, 5, etc.

columns.name: Emerald Color
columns.description: Emerald Color refers to the emerald's color.

columns.name: Emerald Width (mm)
columns.description: Emerald Width refers to the breadth, broadness or wideness of the emerald. Please ensure that the values entered are in Millimeters. Possible values are 2.5, 5, etc.

columns.name: Emerald Height (mm)
columns.description: Emerald Height refers to the measurement from top to base or head to foot of the emerald. Please ensure that the values entered are in Millimeters. Possible values are 2.5, 5, etc.

columns.name: Emerald Weight (carat)
columns.description: Emerald Weight refers to the weight of the emerald only, without packaging. Please ensure that the values entered are in Carats. Possible values are 0.5, 2.5, etc.

columns.name: Sapphire Color
columns.description: Sapphire Color refers to the sapphire's color.

columns.name: Sapphire Width (mm)
columns.description: Sapphire Width refers to the breadth, broadness or wideness of the sapphire. Please ensure that the values entered are in Millimeters. Possible values are 2.5, 5, etc.

columns.name: Sapphire Height (mm)
columns.description: Sapphire Height refers to the measurement from top to base or head to foot of the sapphire. Please ensure that the values entered are in Millimeters. Possible values are 2.5, 5, etc.

columns.name: Sapphire Weight (carat)
columns.description: Sapphire Weight refers to the weight of the sapphire only, without packaging. Please ensure that the values entered are in Carats. Possible values are 0.5, 2.5, etc.

columns.name: Amethyst Color
columns.description: Amethyst Color refers to the amethyst's color.

columns.name: Amethyst Width (mm)
columns.description: Amethyst Width refers to the breadth, broadness or wideness of the amethyst. Please ensure that the values entered are in Millimeters. Possible values are 2.5, 5, etc.

columns.name: Amethyst Height (mm)
columns.description: Amethyst Height refers to the measurement from top to base or head to foot of the amethyst. Please ensure that the values entered are in Millimeters. Possible values are 2.5, 5, etc.

columns.name: Amethyst Weight (carat)
columns.description: Amethyst Weight refers to the weight of the amethyst only, without packaging. Please ensure that the values entered are in Carats. Possible values are 0.5, 2.5, etc.

columns.name: Pearl Color
columns.description: Pearl Color refers to the pearl's color.

columns.name: Pearl Length (mm)
columns.description: Pearl Length refers to the measurement from top to base or head to foot of the pearl. Please ensure that the values entered are in Millimeters. Possible values are 2.5, 5, etc.

columns.name: Width (mm)
columns.description: Width refers to the overall breadth, broadness or wideness of a product. Please ensure that the values entered are in Millimeters. Possible values are 5.4, 6, etc.

columns.name: Height (mm)
columns.description: Height refers to the overall measurement from top to base or head to foot. Please ensure that the values entered are in Millimeters. Possible values are 15.89, 20, etc.

columns.name: Diameter (mm)
columns.description: Diameter refers to a straight line passing from side to side through the center of a body or figure, especially a circle or sphere. Please ensure that the values entered are in Millimeters. Possible values are 5, 14.5, etc.

columns.name: Weight (g)
columns.description: Weight refers to the weight of the product only, without packaging. Please ensure that the values entered are in Grams. Possible values are 70.5, 75, etc.

columns.name: Other Dimensions
columns.description: Other Dimensions refers to any additional information on the dimensions of the product that would be useful to a customer.

columns.name: Other Features
columns.description: Other Features refers to any additional information on the features of the product that would be useful to a customer. Possible values are Handmade, Bendy & Wearable, Gentle Fit, etc.

columns.name: Description
columns.description: Please write few lines describing your product along with a list of products that are compatible with this product. Description is limited to 10000 characters (including spaces). It should not include any hyperlinks, additional offers, or promotion text.

columns.name: Search Keywords
columns.example: Red Casual Tshirt for Women::Black Mens Tshirt::Printed Tshirt
columns.description: Search Keywords refers to the words which the customer might use to find a product. These keywords are tagged to the product and when the buyer searches with the appropriate search word(s), the nearest appropriate product is retrieved and displayed on Flipkart website. The search output is also based on multiple other factors such as Product Quality, Pricing, etc. Please enter a maximum of 5 keywords for this purpose.

columns.name: Key Features
columns.description: Key Features refers to the defining features of a product that can be highlighted on the website.

columns.name: Ornamentation Type
columns.description: Ornamentation Type refers to the decorative elements added to the product to enhance its appearance and make it more attractive

columns.name: Net Quantity
columns.description: Net Quantity refers to the total number of items that the customer will receive as part of the sales package.

columns.name: Brand Color
columns.description: Brand Color refers to the color or shade of the product as given by the brand. This value can be alphanumeric as well.

columns.name: Supplier Image
columns.description: Supplier Image refers to the name of the image that you will upload.
